title: In-depth analysis of the interactions of various aryl hydrocarbon receptor ligands from a computational perspective.
authors: Mosa, Farag E S; El-Kadi, Ayman O S; Barakat, Khaled
one_liner_zh: 该文用计算工具构建AhR转录因子PAS-B结构域与配体的动态模型，研究配体结合机制，虽非TF-DNA互作，但涉及转录因子配体结合建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Aryl hydrocarbon receptor (AhR) is a ligand-dependent transcription factor that acts as a machinery that controls the expression of many genes, including cytochrome P450 CYP1A1, CYP1A2 and CYP1B1. It plays a principal role in numerous biological and toxicological functions, making it a promising target for developing therapeutic agents. Several novel small molecules targeting the AhR signaling pathway are currently under investigation as antitumor agents. Some have already advanced into clinical trials in patients with various tumors. Activation of AhR by diverse chemicals either endogenous or exogenous is initiated by the binding of these ligands to the PAS-B domain, which modulates AhR functions. There is, however, limited information about how various ligands interact with the PAS-B domain for activating or inhibiting the AhR. To better understand the mode of action of AhR agonists/antagonists. The current work proposes a combination of several computational tools to build dynamical models for the PAS-B domain bound to different ligands in mouse and human. Our findings reveal the essential roles of specific PAS-B residues (e.g., S365, V381& Q383), which mediate the AhR ligand-binding process. Our results also explain how these residues regulate the promiscuity of AhR in accommodating various chemicals in its binding PAS-B ligand-binding pocket.
abstract_zh: 芳香烃受体（Aryl hydrocarbon receptor, AhR）是一种配体依赖性转录因子，作为调控多种基因（包括细胞色素P450 CYP1A1、CYP1A2和CYP1B1）表达的机制，在众多生物学和毒理学功能中发挥主要作用，使其成为开发治疗药物的有前景靶点。目前，多种靶向AhR信号通路的新型小分子正在作为抗肿瘤药物进行研究，其中一些已进入针对多种肿瘤患者的临床试验阶段。由内源性或外源性多种化学物质激活AhR的过程，始于这些配体与PAS-B结构域的结合，该结合调节AhR功能。然而，关于不同配体如何与PAS-B结构域相互作用以激活或抑制AhR的信息仍然有限。为更好地理解AhR激动剂/拮抗剂的作用模式，本研究提出结合多种计算工具，构建小鼠和人类中PAS-B结构域与不同配体结合的动态模型。我们的发现揭示了特定PAS-B残基（如S365、V381和Q383）在介导AhR配体结合过程中的关键作用，并解释了这些残基如何调节AhR在其PAS-B配体结合口袋中容纳多种化学物质的混杂性。
